# GE Financial Performance Summary: FY2025

GE delivered strong growth in FY2025, with revenue reaching $45.9B (+18.5% year-over-year) and net income rebounding to $8.7B (+32.8%). Operating cash flow surged to $8.5B (+81.3%), though cash balances declined to $12.4B (-9.0%) as long-term debt increased to $18.8B (+9.1%).

## Revenue and Profitability

Revenue grew to $45.9B in FY2025, up +18.5% from $38.7B in FY2024. Net income recovered to $8.7B, representing +32.8% growth from the prior year's $6.6B. This marks a strong rebound after FY2024 net income declined -30.9% to $6.6B from FY2023's $9.5B.

## Cash Generation and Liquidity

Operating cash flow improved significantly to $8.5B in FY2025, up +81.3% from $4.7B in FY2024. However, cash on hand decreased to $12.4B from $13.6B, a decline of -9.0%. Long-term debt increased to $18.8B from $17.2B, representing +9.1% growth.

## Caveats

FY2023 net income of $9.5B and operating cash flow of $5.2B were subject to immaterial revisions. FY2023 revenue of $35.3B was affected by discontinued operations and is not directly comparable to subsequent years.
